### Observed differences

- In the later window, activities A15, A23, A24, and A25 are no longer observed, whereas they were present in all 200 traces before. [OCC002, OCC006, OCC007, OCC008]
- Activities A14, A16, A17, and A18 appear in the later window in about 27%, 20%, 29%, and 26% of traces respectively, having been absent before. [OCC001, OCC003, OCC004, OCC005]
- The successor distribution of A41 changed from A15/A23/A24/A25 to A14/A16/A17/A18, and the new activities all lead to A26. [DIR009, DIR001, DIR003, DIR004, DIR005]
- The lag between A41 and A26 changed from 5 steps to 2 steps. [LAG001]

### Inference

Support level: Insufficient evidence

The evidence is insufficient to infer a structural change in the process. The many agreeing items all reflect a single underlying difference — the replacement of one set of activities by another — which is not clearly larger than the number of differences expected by chance under the screening (0.59 expected).
